body:
@Haroenv yes we should be able to either integrate it in circleci or within shipjs, whichever makes it easier to commit the staged changes from the auto fix.

@shaejaz lerna doesn't support synchronizing versions for a sub-group of packages in the monorepo. We rely on a `test:versions` to block the pipeline and up until now someone has to fix the versions manually (in package.jsons, adding a changelog entry, etc.). This process can now be automated with the current PR.
